title: § 28-307.2 Unannounced inspections of workplaces by fire department.

blocks.html:
In addition to any other inspections required by law or rule, the fire department shall conduct a minimum of 50 unannounced workplace inspections annually to ensure the identification and abatement of any hazardous conditions in violation of section 28-307.1. Such inspections shall include, but not be limited to, sites where there are known or suspected conditions affecting employee safety and health.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
